entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered about 25 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They don't fit. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but the cycling shoes just give me blisters after a few miles. It's ridiculous.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters and not working out for you. I understand that can be very frustrating. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that your purchase is well within our 90-day return policy. I can go ahead and process this for a full refund for you.
Oh. I was expecting a problem. So you're just going to take them back?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 90-day window, you're all set. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label and instructions right now. You just need to box them up and drop them off.
Whatever. I guess that's easier than I thought it would be. Just send the email.
The email is on its way to you now. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
